title: Services - Bracket Bear
subtitle: Creative Technology Partner
metaDescription: Bracket Bear offers three flexible ways to partner with experience agencies: Augment Your Team, Deliver the Project, and Consult & Collaborate.

hero.title: Services
hero.subtitle: We help experiential agencies bring bold ideas to life — through care, craft, and technical clarity.

intro.title: Intro
intro.content:
Every partnership with Bracket Bear is built on empathy and execution.
We adapt to how you work and provide the right level of support to keep your projects running smoothly.
Our three modes of service are designed to meet you where you are — and scale with you as you grow.

serviceModes.title: Augment Your Team
serviceModes.description:
When your pipeline gets heavy or your project needs specialized expertise, we embed directly with your team.
Think of us as an extension of your in-house crew — following your direction, aligning with your workflow, and helping you hit deadlines without compromise.
Our presence is seamless, our communication clear, and our focus steady.
You stay in creative flow; we make sure the work moves forward.

serviceModes.title: Deliver the Project
serviceModes.description:
Sometimes you just need someone to own it.
We manage delivery from prototype to on-site installation, taking full responsibility for technical build, coordination, and launch.
You lead the creative vision; we bring it to life — with precision, reliability, and hospitality in every detail.
From interactive installations to CMS-driven experiences, we deliver the work so you can focus on leading your clients.

serviceModes.title: Consult & Collaborate
serviceModes.description:
When you're exploring new territory or refining process, we help you find clarity.
Through audits, workshops, and ongoing collaboration, we share the perspective shaped by years of building systems, tools, and experiences.
We help you make confident, informed decisions — the kind that move teams forward and keep ideas alive.

contactCTA.text:
Whatever your magic wand would fix — that's where we start.
Let's build something unforgettable together.
